blurb: Bluefin Sound Charters offers private fishing trips in Western Long Island Sound and the East River, focusing on striped bass and other species. Trips are hands-on and adaptable, using multiple fishing techniques including jigging, popping, live bait, and trolling. The fleet includes a Steiger Craft 255 Miami boat with capacity for up to six passengers.
